item.text: The main point to flag is that checkout recovery did not mean payment recovery was complete: 11 orders still need customer 3-D Secure action, so the 10:00 update must not say all affected payments are settled. Payments operations acknowledged the escalation and plans to send re-authorization emails after 10:00. Also, the API rollback would have been unsafe because v42 removed a column that v41 still reads.
